messages:
Sam (sam.sales): Hey team — Zelda Health wants to ramp their POC next week and asked if we can bump their Dedicated pool commit + temporary burst. They need higher steady throughput for 3 weeks. Can someone confirm availability and pricing impact?
Nina (nina.se): @Sam what numbers are they expecting? region? model size? also do they need VPC/private lane or just Dedicated hosted access?
Sam (sam.sales): Asking for 2x current commit. Region: us-west. Model: redwood-7b-quant. Expected sustained ~120 reqs/s (avg 32 tokens per req) during the demo window. They'll need API keys for Dedicated and a service account for telemetry. VPC not required for this POC.
Jordan (jordan.ops): Us-west Dedicated pool has room but we need to know exact committed GPU-hours to change the reserved capacity. Quick Q: do they want autoscale enabled with a burst cap, or a straight commit increase? Autoscale + burst is preferred for them.
Sam (sam.sales): Autoscale + burst. They want a guaranteed floor (commit) and ability to burst up to ~3x during peak demo times. Demo dates: start 2026-04-06 for 3 weeks.
Tess (tess.sre): If no VPC, that's simpler. But security asked about audit logs and KMS keys for telemetry — we need to confirm they're OK with Redwood-managed logs + optional encrypted bucket. Also need to check whether the SSO/SCIM access is needed for their engineers.
Alex (alex.finance): Pricing note: short-term commit increases are handled as pro-rated month charges. We can offer marketing credits for up to 2 weeks of the uplift, but anything beyond that will be billed in the reserved contract. Need approval from RevOps for credits.
Nina (nina.se): For autoscale policy, here's a sample config I usually send. Paste this in the POC ticket and we can apply it to the pool.
Nina (nina.se): ```
autoscale:
  min_commit: 4
  target_rps: 100
  burst_cap: 12
  cooldown_sec: 900
  fallback_model: redwood-3b-quant
```
Nina (nina.se): Change min_commit to match the committed GPUs/hours. Burst cap is in equivalent GPU units.
Jordan (jordan.ops): From infra side we can flip this on Monday if RevOps signs off and we get the revised PO/commit amount. We'll also attach an ephemeral API key for the POC engineers scoped to the pool.
Sam (sam.sales): Great. I'll push for RevOps approval today and send the PO. Can deploy-bot provision an ephemeral key once the pool config is set?
deploy-bot: Pool 'dedicated-usw-zelda-poc' has 6 reserved units available. To provision burst above reserved units, submit an ops change ticket referencing CHG-8271.
Jordan (jordan.ops): Thanks @deploy-bot — I'll create CHG-8271 and link to the PO. Also tagging @Tess: need SRE ok for audit config (we will enable long-retention logs for this POC).
Tess (tess.sre): Ok from SRE for long-retention logs. For KMS, we'll use our managed key unless Zelda requires their own. If they do, we need their KMS ARN and IAM contact before cutover.
Alex (alex.finance): Once PO arrives, I'll calculate the pro-rate and optional credit. Sam — include expected peak tokens/day so I can estimate unit charges.
Sam (sam.sales): Peak tokens/day ~ 3.6M tokens. I'll update the PO + send Zelda the security note re: KMS.
Nina (nina.se): Heads up — if they plan many short-lived sessions we should enable prefix caching to shave cost. I'll include that tip in the handoff docs. :thumbsup:
Sam (sam.sales): Perfect. Plan: RevOps/Finance sign PO by EOD, Jordan to open CHG ticket for burst, Nina to prepare autoscale config, Tess to confirm logs/KMS path, I will provide Zelda with ephemeral API key instructions. Will update thread with PO when done. Thanks all!
